## Results

### Search process and data collection

Ten thousand three hundred ninety-two articles were identified in a search performed for a larger systematic review evaluating the diagnostic performance of LSM-VCTE and other index tests for the staging of fibrosis and diagnosis of NASH in adult patients with NAFLD. After removing duplicates, and screening titles, abstracts, and full texts, 59 studies examining VCTE were identified. The authors of 37 studies shared useable data ([figure 1](#F1)). Authors of more than one study supplied data in a single dataset and, overall, we received 30 data sets including data from 6571 patients. After removing duplicates (n=628) and patients with missing biopsy (n=14) or LSM-VCTE (n=194) data, the final dataset consisted of 5735 unique patients.

### Study and population characteristics

The characteristics of the 30 data sets are summarised in [table 1](#T1). Studies were conducted in Europe (67%), Asia (40%) and Australia (3%). Data availability is shown in [online supplemental table 3](#SP1). FIB-4 and NFS were determined in 5393 (94%) and 3248 (57%) cases, respectively. Median age was 54 years, 2570 (45%) patients were women, 33% had diabetes and 43% had BMI ≥30 kg/m2. Overall, 30% had advanced fibrosis and 11% had cirrhosis. Details of the IPD study group are included in [table 2](#T2), and [online supplemental tables 4 and 5](#SP1).

### Study quality

The methodological quality of the studies assessed with the QUADAS-2 tool is summarised in [online supplemental figures 2 and 3](#SP1). Only one study had low risk of bias or low applicability concerns in all QUADAS-2 domains.[28](#R28) The flow and timing domain were judged to have high risk or unclear risk of bias in 65% of studies, as these either excluded technical failures from their final diagnostic performance analysis or did not report them.

### Validating the diagnostic performance of LSM by VCTE and serum-based tests for detecting advanced fibrosis

LSM-VCTE, FIB-4, NFS, APRI and AST/ALT had corresponding AUROCs of 0.85, 0.76, 0.73, 0.70, 0.64 for identifying advanced fibrosis ([table 3](#T3)), and 0.90, 0.80, 0.78, 0.72, 0.69 for the identification of cirrhosis ([online supplemental table 6](#SP1)). LSM-VCTE performed significantly better (p<10−15) in detecting both advanced fibrosis and cirrhosis than all serum-based tests. This relationship was preserved when performing a head-to-head comparison of LSM-VCTE, FIB-4 and NFS in the same group of patients ([online supplemental tables 7 and 8](#SP1)).

When considering cut-offs from the literature, we evaluated lower and higher cut-offs separately. For any given test, as would be expected, low thresholds yielded higher sensitivity and high thresholds were associated with higher specificity ([online supplemental table 9](#SP1)). Indicative PPV and NPV are also provided for the range of prevalences (5%–50%) reported in the primary studies ([online supplemental tables 10–14](#SP1)).

APRI and AST/ALT ratio had only modest diagnostic performance for advanced fibrosis (AUROC ≤0.70, [table 3](#T3)), and were therefore not considered further.

None of the thresholds regarded in isolation resulted in both a high sensitivity (≥80%) and high specificity (≥80%) ([figure 2](#F2), [table 3](#T3), [online supplemental tables 9 and 15](#SP1), and [online supplemental figure 4](#SP1)). Therefore, we explored the use of a lower and an upper cut-off. LSM-VCTE literature cut-offs performed well in only two cases (<7.1 kPa and ≥14.1 kPa: 83% sensitivity, 90% specificity; and <7.9 kPa and ≥9.6 kPa: 84% sensitivity, 78% specificity), while for other LSM-VCTE, NFS and FIB-4 thresholds a high specificity was observed (FIB-4: 91% for <1.3 and ≥2.67, 95% for <1.3, ≥3.25) but sensitivity was <60% ([table 4](#T4)). In addition, the proportion of indeterminate cases was >30% for serum-based NITs. Threshold pairs derived from the IPD study group did not reduce the proportion of misclassified and indeterminate patients seen with literature-based threshold pairs ([table 4](#T4)).

We further evaluated the performance of LSM-VCTE, FIB-4 and NFS to diagnose advanced fibrosis in sequential combinations of serum-based NITs and LSM-VCTE. When selecting threshold combinations for FIB-4 and NFS available in the literature (<1.3 & ≥2.67,<1.3 & ≥3.25 for FIB-4;<−1.455 & ≥0.676 for NFS) and pairing them with the best threshold pair for LSM-VCTE (<7.9 kPa & ≥9.6 kPa, identified as the one with highest sensitivity and lowest indeterminate proportion), the proportion of patients in the indeterminate group was 5%. While both the FIB-4+LSM VCTE and NFS+LSM VCTE sequential combinations had specificity >80%, their sensitivity was ≤80% ([table 5](#T5)). A better sensitivity was reached by using thresholds derived from the IPD study group (<0.88 & ≥2.31 for FIB-4;<−2.55 & ≥0.28 for NFS), but the proportion of indeterminate cases was near 20% in those cases and the proportions of patients needing LSM-VCTE was also larger than when using literature cut-offs ([table 5](#T5)).

### Algorithms to minimise the need for liver biopsy

In the derivation set, the cut-offs for 95% and 98% specificity for the diagnosis of cirrhosis were respectively 20.4 kPa and 27.6 kPa for LSM-VCTE, 3.48 and 4.63 for FIB-4 and 1.01 and 1.57 for NFS. These cut-offs performed similarly in the validation set ([online supplemental tables 16 and 17](#SP1)).

Algorithms combining FIB-4 (lower cut-off of 1.3 as described in the literature and upper cut-offs of 3.48 and 4.63 as described above) and LSM by VCTE (lower cut-off rounded to 8.0 kPa and upper cut-offs rounded to 20.0 kPa and 28.0 kPa, as described above) were then compared with the traditional way of applying these tests, also with rounded cut-offs for LSM by VCTE (8 kPa and 10 kPa) ([figure 3](#F3)). This approach increased the number of patients requiring a LSM (from 34% to 40% and 44%) but decreased the number of patients needing liver biopsy (from 33% to 19% and 24% when using the 95% and 98% specificity cut-offs, respectively) ([online supplemental table 18](#SP1) and [figure 3](#F3)).

### Subgroup and sensitivity analyses

In subgroup analysis for the diagnosis of advanced fibrosis ([online supplemental table 19](#SP1)), NITs performed better in patients with lower BMI (AUROCs LSM-VCTE: 0.91, p<0.005; FIB-4: 0.81, p<0.001; NFS: 0.76, p<0.025), without T2DM (LSM-VCTE: 0.87, p<10−6; FIB-4: 0.77, p<0.01), and with biopsies shorter than 20 mm (LSM-VCTE: 0.87, p<0.005; FIB-4: 0.80, p<0.001; NFS: 0.79, p<0.05), or with fewer than 11 portal tracts (LSM-VCTE: 0.86, p=0.01; FIB-4: 0.79, p=0.04; NFS: 0.78, p<0.005). Diagnostic performance was also lower in patients in the youngest age quartile (<43 years, AUROC: 0.58, p<0.001) and in women (AUROC: 0.71, p=0.03) for NFS, while continent of provenance did not have a significant effect for any NITs. In patients with normal levels of ALT (ALT<40) FIB-4 performed worse (AUROC: 0.73) than in patients with ALT≥40 and ALT<100 (AUROC: 0.77, p<0.01). NFS performed better in patients with AST<40 (AUROC: 0.76), than in patients with AST≥100 (AUROC: 0.65, p<0.01). FIB-4 performed better in patients with at least one abnormal aminotransferase measurement (AUROC: 0.72, p=0.014). For cirrhosis, the trends were similar, except that for the diagnosis of cirrhosis, LSM by VCTE performed better in the youngest age group (AUROC: 0.97, p<10−4) and NIT diagnostic performance was independent of aminotransferase levels ([online supplemental table 20](#SP1)).

The diagnostic performance of LSM-VCTE was significantly lower in patients with unreliable LSMs (p<10−8; both for advanced fibrosis and cirrhosis) when applying the Boursier-criteria,[22](#R22) but not when only considering IQR/median LSM <0.30. The proportion of unreliable results was 12% both in the advanced fibrosis and cirrhosis groups ([online supplemental table 21](#SP1)).

There was no difference in the diagnostic performance of LSM-VCTE between the M and XL probes in the subgroup of patients who had undergone LSM by both probes ([online supplemental table 22](#SP1)).

In a sensitivity analysis of patients with LSM matched to BMI (only M probe measurements if BMI <30 kg/m2 and only XL probe measurements if BMI ≥30 kg/m2), there was no significant difference between the diagnostic performance of LSM-VCTE when comparing to the entire IPD study group ([online supplemental table 23](#SP1)).

## Discussion

Through an extensive collaboration network with authors of primary studies we were able to collect the largest dataset of its kind ever to be reported on. This includes a diverse set of study groups from Europe, Asia, and Australia, 30% of whom had advanced fibrosis. We believe that our findings are therefore relevant for patients typical of secondary care in these territories and may be applied in the development of new strategies or in the consolidation of existing practices in evaluating patients for referral to secondary care.

A few studies evaluated the diagnostic performance of LSM-VCTE and other NITs, but most report on fewer than 500 patients. One similarly large study reported on patients screened for inclusion in clinical trials, where the prevalence of advanced fibrosis was 71%,[29](#R29) making it difficult to make generalisations about its applicability in routine practice or compare its results to ours. A smaller study with 1073 patients with NAFLD of whom 29% had advanced fibrosis[30](#R30) examined the diagnostic performance of LSM by VCTE. The authors of that study reported AUC and specificity values similar to our findings, however they reported increased sensitivity. Other smaller studies reported similar prevalence of advanced fibrosis and similar AUROCs for LSM-VCTE.[31–34](#R31)

Overall, the diagnostic performance of LSM-VCTE for advanced fibrosis was good (AUROC=0.85), while that of FIB-4 and NFS in the same group was moderate (AUROC=0.76 for FIB-4, AUROC=0.73 for NFS). None of the studied NITs had both sufficiently high sensitivity and specificity (≥80%) when used with single cut-offs. Diagnostic performance was higher for detecting cirrhosis, as reported in previous studies.[31 35 36](#R31) LSM-VCTE had the highest sensitivity and specificity, both in the case of a single cut-off (9.1 kPa obtained by maximising the Youden index; 77% and 78%) and for two cut-offs (<7.4 kPa & ≥12.1 kPa; 84% and 87%). Of the LSM-VCTE cut-off pairs tested,<7.1 kPa and ≥14.1 kPa, first published by Eddowes *et al*.,[31](#R31) performed well for advanced fibrosis, with sensitivity of 83% and specificity of 90%, but with a proportion of 39% of patients ending up with an indeterminate result, similar to 41% indeterminate patients reported in the original paper.[31](#R31)

LSM-VCTE thresholds identified in our study group (<9.1 kPa; <7.4 kPa & ≥12.1 kPa) were similar to thresholds reported in the literature (<9.9 kPa; <7.1 kPa & ≥14.1 kPa, <7.9 kPa & ≥9.6 kPa). However, thresholds for FIB-4 (<1.44; <0.88 & ≥2.31) and NFS (<−1.39; <−2.55 & ≥0.28) defined in our IPD study group spanned a wider range than those reported in the literature (<1.3 & ≥2.67 or <1.3 & ≥3.25 for FIB-4;<−1.455 & ≥0.676 for NFS).

Our findings are in line with the existing literature suggesting that sequential combinations of NITs increase sensitivity and specificity.[29](#R29) Additionally, we have found NFS+LSM VCTE and FIB-4+LSM VCTE combinations to have similar sensitivity and specificity as recently reported by Boursier *et al*.[37](#R37) Such combined testing strategies can reduce the number of indeterminate cases and reduce the costs associated with liver biopsies.

Furthermore, we propose an approach that could minimise the need for liver biopsies further, by using upper cut-offs with 95% and 98% specificity for the identification of cirrhosis. The rationale for this approach is explained in the [online supplemental discussion](#SP1). When using the 95% specificity cut-off, the proportion of patients needing liver biopsy decreases from 33% to 19% ([figure 3](#F3)). However, in this approach, 345 of 656 patients 'ruled-in' as having cirrhosis do not have histologically diagnosed cirrhosis. While this may seem like a high proportion of patients with false positive results, this must be interpreted in the light of two factors. First, the limitations of liver biopsy could mean that these patients are falsely classified as not having cirrhosis histologically. Furthermore, patients without cirrhosis on histology and with high NIT values could have equivalent risks as patients with cirrhosis on histology. For example, it is known from the hepatitis C literature[38](#R38) that patients without cirrhosis on liver biopsy but with a high FIB-4 (>3.25) still had a significant risk of developing HCC after hepatitis C treatment, demonstrating that NITs can have added benefit beyond the histological diagnosis of cirrhosis alone. The rate of false positive results for cirrhosis can be decreased by choosing cut-offs with higher specificity, but this will come at the expense of doing more biopsies. Despite this encouraging result, this is an area where more information is needed, particularly longitudinal data comparing the prognostic value of LSM-VCTE and other NITs against histology, and ultimately, the cost effectiveness of the various cut-offs would need to be evaluated.

Surprisingly, subgroup analyses showed that the diagnostic accuracy of NITs was better in cases with poor biopsy quality. This finding is difficult to explain but a similar observation was reported previously in a large group of patients screened for clinical trials.[29](#R29) The use of local biopsy reports as reference standard and the well-known observer-dependent variability of biopsy interpretation, even among expert pathologists,[7](#R7) are factors that may have contributed to our finding. Spectrum bias was excluded as a source of this finding due to a near-identical proportion of patients in both the advanced fibrosis and cirrhosis group having short biopsies ([online supplemental table 5](#SP1)).

Subgroup analysis showed better diagnostic performance of NITs in patients with lower BMI,[39 40](#R39) and patients without diabetes, in keeping with other studies.[41 42](#R41) This effect is likely to be primarily driven by BMI as there is thought to be a causal association between BMI and T2DM. NIT performance was impacted by age, with all NITs performing worse in the younger quartile of our study group for advanced fibrosis, but the trend was reversed for cirrhosis where NITs performed better in those younger than 43 years of age. The age dependence of FIB-4 and NFS is expected, as age is one of the parameters included in the algorithms, and has indeed been previously described.[13 43](#R13) It is, however, difficult to explain why performance of NITs is better in the younger age group for the diagnosis of cirrhosis.

Our study has several strengths, including the large size of the IPD study group and composition with prevalence of advanced fibrosis of 30%, which makes it relevant to routine practice. Furthermore, the proportion of unreliable VCTE measurements in our study was 12%, in keeping with the literature.[22](#R22) However, we acknowledge some limitations. We did not have any data from the USA and very few studies from Australia, so the results could not be globally applicable, due to differences in BMI across study populations. In addition, due to the nature of our study, we had to use the locally provided histology results possibly introducing bias. Furthermore, we covered a large chronological period, during which LSM-VCTE application underwent significant changes, initially with the introduction of the XL probe, followed by the advice to measure skin-to-capsule distance (SCD) and the introduction of the Automatic Probe Selection tool. There was therefore some heterogeneity in the performance of LSM-VCTE, with early studies using only the M probe to assess all patients, while only a subset of studies assessed SCD to guide probe selection. Furthermore, one third of the included studies was carried out in France, as the technology used for LSM by VCTE originates from there. Lastly, our data confirm that LSM-VCTE had superior accuracy to serum-based tests, and this is independent of probe type, sex, ALT, AST, and participants' continent of origin. There was, however, some dependence on the presence of T2DM, BMI and for the detection of cirrhosis, and we did not check for subgroup-specific cut-offs, but these should be explored in future studies.

Our study examined some of the most widely available NITs. While it cannot be considered exhaustive, it can be regarded as the benchmark against which newer NITs can be tested. This is particularly important as new tests are continuously being developed (FibroTest-FibroSURE, ActiTest,[44](#R44) ELF[45](#R45)). Furthermore, newer tests are also needed for patients with 'at risk' NASH (NASH+F2–3) who would be candidates for clinical trials or treatments, once approved therapies become available (FAST score,[46](#R46) NIS4,[47](#R47) cTAG[48](#R48)).

In conclusion, our study provides further validation of the use of sequential combination of FIB-4 and LSM-VCTE to rule out patients with NAFLD and advanced fibrosis who can be managed in primary care. We have shown how the use of upper cut-offs to rule in cirrhosis in combination with lower cut-offs to rule out advanced fibrosis can lead to a reduction in the number of patients who would need to undergo liver biopsy.

## Methods

This IPDMA was reported in accordance with the recommendations of the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses-IPD Statement[15](#R15) and was registered as PROSPERO CRD42019157661.

### Criteria for considering studies for the IPD meta-analysis

#### Patients

Studies reporting data on adults (≥18 years) with NAFLD and paired liver histology and LSM-VCTE were eligible. When studies reported study groups of participants with unselected aetiologies, only IPD of those with NAFLD were sought.

#### Index tests

The index test of main interest was LSM-VCTE performed with FibroScan (Echosens, France). Results for serum-based biomarkers NSF,[16](#R16) FIB-4,[17](#R17) aspartate aminotransferase (AST) to alanine aminotransferase (ALT) ratio[18](#R18) and AST-to-platelet ratio index (APRI)[19](#R19)) were also computed where data were available. [Online supplemental table 1](#SP1) summarises the definition of NITs considered in this IPDMA.

Supplementary data

[gutjnl-2021-324243supp001.pdf](/articles/instance/8995830/bin/gutjnl-2021-324243supp001.pdf) (823.5KB, pdf)

Universally accepted cut-offs for diagnosing different groups of fibrosis stages do not exist (several suggested cut-offs are presented in [online supplemental table 2](#SP1)). For LSM-VCTE, <7.9 kPa and ≥9.6 kPa are the most used for respectively ruling out and in, advanced fibrosis.[20](#R20)

#### Reference standard

Only studies reporting histological classification of liver fibrosis based on the non-alcoholic steatohepatitis Clinical Research Network (NASH CRN) staging system were considered.[21](#R21)

#### Target conditions

Advanced fibrosis (F3–4) and cirrhosis (F4) were the target conditions of interest. To fulfil the aims of the study, cut-offs were selected to rule out or rule in advanced fibrosis, and to rule out advanced fibrosis or rule in cirrhosis.

#### Study design

All study designs were considered if they were reporting on patients with NAFLD undergoing both liver biopsy and LSM-VCTE within 6 months. No language restrictions were applied.

### Establishing collaborations

Authors of eligible studies were contacted by email and reminders were sent if a response was not received within 2 weeks. Only data from studies that received ethical approval were used. Additional ethical approval was not sought for the meta-analysis as only anonymised data were provided.

### Data verification

Range checks of measurement values provided for individual patients were carried out and authors were asked to provide clarifications where necessary. Missing data were queried until received or confirmed as unavailable. Missing data were handled in the analysis by pairwise deletion.

LSM-VCTE with median stiffness ≥7.1 kPa and IQR-to-median LSM ratio >30% were considered unreliable.[22](#R22) These were included in the main analysis and were later compared in a subgroup analysis to reliable measurements, to assess whether they can be reliably used to diagnose advanced fibrosis.

Authors were provided with a template table of required data ([online supplemental table 3](#SP1)) and were asked to deduplicate data were possible. We also checked for duplicate entries and where identified these were removed.

### Data analysis

#### Quality and bias assessment

The quality of studies was assessed using the Quality Assessment of Diagnostic Accuracy Studies tool (QUADAS-2).[23](#R23)

#### IPD meta-analysis

The original data sets were merged, a study identification variable was added, and descriptive statistical analysis of the data sets was conducted. Dichotomous variables are displayed as percentages. Continuous variables are reported as means with SD, or medians with IQRs according to the distribution of the data.

Analyses were done per protocol, as we did not have information on failed LSM-VCTE. To express the diagnostic performance of NITs, non-parametric, empirical receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves were constructed for the target conditions of interest. Diagnostic performance was expressed as the area under the ROC curve (AUROC) with 95% CI, based on De Long's method. AUROCs were compared using De Long's test statistic.

Thresholds to maximise the Youden index (ie, sensitivity+specificity−1), for 90% sensitivity, and for 90% specificity were reported. The diagnostic performance of previously published cut-offs was also evaluated. Sequential combinations of serum biomarkers and LSM-VCTE were evaluated, by computing sensitivity, specificity and proportions of misclassified and indeterminate patients.

Positive and negative predictive values (PPV and NPV) were estimated for prevalences within the range of those reported in the original studies. The number of false positive and false negative results for 100 theoretical cases was also reported.

The main analysis was conducted to maximise data for each NIT. For a valid comparison of the performance of NITs, a separate analysis was conducted in the subgroup of patients where all three of VCTE, FIB-4 and NFS were available in each participant.

To fulfil the aim of developing testing strategies that reduce the number of patients in need of a liver biopsy, lower cut-offs for ruling out advanced fibrosis and upper cut-offs for ruling in cirrhosis were used. The rationale for this approach is illustrated in [online supplemental figure 1](#SP1). The upper cut-offs for identifying cirrhosis were chosen at 95% and 98% specificity in a derivation set and tested in a validation set. Derivation and validation sets were obtained by random sampling from the IPD study group in a 3:2 ratio. These upper cut-offs were combined with lower cut-offs from the literature for ruling out advanced fibrosis and the algorithm was tested in the whole IPD study group. For ease of reference, we also examined the cut-offs of 8 kPa and 10 kPa (corresponding to the most common VCTE cut-offs in the literature of 7.9 kPa and 9.6 kPa rounded to the nearest integer) and also rounded our cirrhosis cut-offs to the nearest integer to facilitate application in clinical practice.

Only test-positive and test-negative patients were included in the calculation of diagnostic performance indices, and patients in the indeterminate group were excluded from calculations.

Subgroup analysis was performed according to biopsy length (<20 mm, ≥20 mm), number of portal tracts in biopsy samples (<11, ≥11), biopsy quality (intermediate: 10 mm ≤length <20 mm; high: length ≥20 mm and ≥11 tracts), age (four quartiles), sex, body mass index (BMI; BMI <25 kg/m2, 25 kg/m2≤ BMI <30 kg/m2, BMI ≥30 kg/m2), presence of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), continent of provenance (Europe, Asia), probes used (M, XL), reliability criteria for LSM-VCTE (reliable (median LSM <7.1 kPa or median LSM ≥7.1 kPa and IQR/median LSM <0.30) vs unreliable (median LSM ≥7.1 kPa and IQR/median LSM ≥0.30)[22](#R22); reliable (IQR/median LSM <0.30) vs unreliable (IQR/median LSM ≥0.30)), and aminotransferase levels (ALT or AST<40, 40≤ALT or AST<100, ALT or AST≥100; ALT<40 and AST<40, ALT≥40 or AST≥40.

All statistical analyses were performed using R (V.1.2.1335, R Foundation for Statistical Computing, Vienna, Austria) with the pROC package[24 25](#R24); 95% CIs were calculated using 500 stratified bootstrap replicates using the boot package.[26 27](#R26)

#### VCTE probe types

The analysis to account for probe type is described in the [online supplemental materials](#SP1).

### Patient and public involvement

Patients and the public were not involved in the conduct of this study as there was no direct patient participation in the study.

# 基于个体患者数据荟萃分析评估无创检测对 NAFLD 患者晚期肝纤维化的诊断准确性

## ——一篇已发表论文的结构化重述

> **原文献信息**  
> Mózes FE, Lee JA, Selvaraj EA, et al. Diagnostic accuracy of non-invasive tests for advanced fibrosis in patients with NAFLD: an individual patient data meta-analysis. *Gut*. 2022 May;71(5):1006–1019.  
> **DOI**: [10.1136/gutjnl-2021-324243](https://doi.org/10.1136/gutjnl-2021-324243)  
> **PMID**: 34001645  
> **PMCID**: [PMC8995830](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC8995830/)  
> **PROSPERO 注册号**: CRD42019157661  
> **许可协议**: CC BY-NC 4.0  
> **说明**: 以下内容是对原文献的结构化科学重述，所有方法、样本量、主要数值、局限性和结论均来自可核验原文；非逐字复制。

---

## 摘要

**目的**: 在非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD）患者中，肝活检目前仍然是纤维化分期的必要手段。本研究旨在评估振动控制瞬时弹性成像测量的肝脏硬度（LSM-VCTE）、Fibrosis-4 指数（FIB-4）和 NAFLD 纤维化评分（NFS）各自的诊断表现，并推导可减少肝活检需求的诊断策略。

**设计**: 对以肝组织学为参考标准评估 LSM-VCTE 的研究进行个体患者数据荟萃分析（IPDMA）。在数据可获取的情况下计算 FIB-4 和 NFS。计算灵敏度、特异度和受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）。对各标志物单独及序贯联合使用进行评估。

**结果**: 纳入 37 项原始研究的数据（n=5735；女性 45%；中位年龄 54 岁；中位体重指数 30 kg/m²；33% 患有 2 型糖尿病；30% 存在晚期肝纤维化）。LSM-VCTE、FIB-4 和 NFS 单独诊断晚期肝纤维化的 AUROC 分别为 0.85、0.76 和 0.73。序贯联合使用 FIB-4 切点（<1.3；≥2.67）后再行 LSM-VCTE（<8.0；≥10.0 kPa）以排除或纳入晚期肝纤维化，灵敏度（95% CI）为 66%（63–68），特异度为 86%（84–87），33% 的患者仍需肝活检以确定最终诊断。FIB-4 切点（<1.3；≥3.48）后接 LSM-VCTE 切点（<8.0；≥20.0 kPa）以排除晚期肝纤维化或纳入肝硬化，灵敏度为 38%（37–39），特异度为 90%（89–91），19% 的患者需肝活检。

**结论**: 采用较低切点排除晚期肝纤维化、较高切点纳入肝硬化的序贯联合策略，可减少肝活检需求。

---

## 引言

非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD）是代谢综合征的肝脏表现，全球患病率较高。大多数患者长期无明显症状且疾病进展缓慢，但少数会进展为肝硬化、肝功能衰竭和肝细胞癌（HCC）。NAFLD 的组织学特征包括单纯性脂肪变性到伴有小叶炎症和肝细胞气球样变的脂肪性肝炎，两者均可伴随不同程度的纤维化。目前公认的 NAFLD 诊断参考标准仍是肝活检，然而肝活检为侵入性检查且存在并发症风险，同时受限于取样变异性和观察者间病理报告的一致性差异。

NAFLD 通常在血液检查中发现肝转氨酶升高，或在影像学检查中发现肝脏脂肪变性或肝硬化后偶然诊断。临床医生面临的挑战之一是识别哪些患者具有较高的进展或临床结局风险，因为这些患者可从专科随访中获益。现有大量证据表明，至少存在晚期肝纤维化（F3–4）的患者在后期发生肝脏相关事件的风险更高。

已有大量证据表明无创检测（NITs）可用于对患者进行晚期肝纤维化风险分层。这些方法通常涉及序贯应用两种 NITs：第一层在社区进行简单、廉价的血清学检测（如 FIB-4 或 NFS），随后第二层进行肝脏硬度测量（LSM）（如 VCTE）或专有血清学检测（如增强肝纤维化检测，ELF）。每层检测通常使用一个下切点和一个上切点来分别排除（NIT 结果低于下切点者）或纳入（NIT 结果高于上切点者）晚期肝纤维化高风险患者。两轮检测结果均处于不确定区间的患者仍需肝活检进行风险分层。这些方法的主要价值在于其高阴性预测值，可用于排除低风险患者，使其在初级保健中安全管理。

然而，这些方法的若干应用方面仍需进一步明确。首先，关于应使用哪些 NIT 阈值尚无共识——如 FIB-4 的上切点有 3.25 和 2.67 等不同报道。其次，NITs 在特定患者亚组（如糖尿病或肥胖患者）中的表现仍存在不确定性。此外，对于被判定为晚期肝纤维化高风险的患者，仍需通过肝活检识别肝硬化以进行 HCC 监测。因此，开发可减少二级诊疗中肝活检需求的策略是一个尚未满足的需求。

为此，本研究开展了一项 IPDMA，主要目的有三：（1）评估 LSM-VCTE 的诊断表现，并与 FIB-4 和 NFS 作为排除晚期肝纤维化的筛查工具进行比较；（2）评估 NIT 联合策略以最小化二级诊疗中需肝活检的病例数；（3）探索影响诊断准确性的因素。

---

## 方法

### 方案注册与报告规范

本 IPDMA 依照 PRISMA-IPD 声明进行报告，并在 PROSPERO 注册（CRD42019157661）。

### 纳入标准

**受试者**: 报告有 NAFLD 且同时具备肝组织学和 LSM-VCTE 数据的成年患者（≥18 岁）的研究均可纳入。若研究纳入混合病因的患者，仅提取其中 NAFLD 患者的个体数据。

**目标检测**: 主要目标检测为使用 FibroScan（Echosens，法国）进行的 LSM-VCTE。在数据可获取的情况下，同时计算血清学生物标志物 NFS、FIB-4、AST/ALT 比值和 APRI。对于 LSM-VCTE，最常使用的排除和纳入晚期肝纤维化的切点分别为 <7.9 kPa 和 ≥9.6 kPa。

**参考标准**: 仅纳入基于 NASH 临床研究网络（NASH CRN）分期系统报告肝纤维化组织学分级的研究。

**目标状态**: 晚期肝纤维化（F3–4）和肝硬化（F4）。为达成研究目标，切点分别用于排除或纳入晚期肝纤维化，以及排除晚期肝纤维化或纳入肝硬化。

**研究设计**: 所有报告 NAFLD 患者在肝活检前后 6 个月内接受 LSM-VCTE 检查的研究均可纳入，无语言限制。

### 合作建立

通过电子邮件联系合格研究的作者，若 2 周内未收到回复则发送提醒。仅使用已获伦理批准的研究数据。由于仅接收匿名数据，本荟萃分析未另行申请伦理批准。

### 数据验证

对研究者提供的个体患者测量值进行范围检查，必要时要求作者澄清。缺失数据持续追踪直至收到或确认不可获取，分析中采用成对删除法处理缺失数据。

将中位硬度 ≥7.1 kPa 且 IQR/中位 LSM 比值 >30% 的测量视为不可靠。这些数据纳入主要分析，随后在亚组分析中与可靠测量进行比较，以评估其是否可用于可靠诊断晚期肝纤维化。

向作者提供数据模板并要求在可能的情况下去重。同时检查是否存在重复条目，如发现则予以删除。

### 数据分析

**质量与偏倚评估**: 使用 QUADAS-2 工具评估研究质量。

**IPD 荟萃分析**: 合并原始数据集并添加研究识别变量，进行描述性统计分析。分类变量以百分比表示，连续变量以均数 ± 标准差或中位数与四分位距报告。

分析按方案进行（无失败的 LSM-VCTE 信息）。构建非参数经验 ROC 曲线评估诊断表现，基于 De Long 方法计算 AUROC 及 95% CI。AUROC 的组间比较采用 De Long 检验统计量。

报告最大化 Youden 指数、90% 灵敏度和 90% 特异度对应的切点，同时评估已发表文献切点的诊断表现。通过计算灵敏度、特异度以及误分类和不确定患者的比例来评估血清标志物与 LSM-VCTE 的序贯联合策略。

在原始研究报告的患病率范围内估算 PPV 和 NPV，同时报告每 100 例理论病例中的假阳性和假阴性数。

主要分析对每种 NIT 最大化可用数据。为有效比较 NITs 的诊断表现，在同时拥有 VCTE、FIB-4 和 NFS 数据的患者亚组中进行单独的头对头分析。

为实现减少肝活检需求的策略开发，采用较低切点排除晚期肝纤维化、较高切点纳入肝硬化。肝硬化的上切点从推导集中分别选择 95% 和 98% 特异度所对应的值，并在验证集中检验。推导集和验证集通过从 IPD 研究组中以 3:2 比例随机抽样获得。然后将这些上切点与文献中的晚期肝纤维化排除下切点联合，在整个 IPD 研究组中检验。为便于临床使用，还将 7.9 kPa 和 9.6 kPa 取整为 8.0 kPa 和 10.0 kPa，将肝硬化的切点也取整至最近整数。

仅将检测阳性和阴性的患者纳入诊断性能指标计算，不确定区间内的患者被排除。

**亚组分析**: 按以下变量分层：活检长度（<20 mm、≥20 mm）、汇管区数量（<11、≥11）、活检质量（中等：10 mm ≤ 长度 <20 mm；高质量：长度 ≥20 mm 且 ≥11 个汇管区）、年龄（四分位数）、性别、BMI（<25 kg/m²、25–30 kg/m²、≥30 kg/m²）、是否患 2 型糖尿病、来源大洲（欧洲、亚洲）、探头类型（M、XL）、LSM-VCTE 可靠性标准以及转氨酶水平（ALT 或 AST <40、40–100、≥100；ALT <40 且 AST <40、ALT ≥40 或 AST ≥40）。

所有统计采用 R（V.1.2.1335）的 pROC 包完成；95% CI 基于 boot 包采用 500 次分层 bootstrap 重抽样计算。

### 患者与公众参与

本研究未涉及患者和公众的直接参与。

---

## 结果

### 检索流程与数据收集

在一项评估 LSM-VCTE 和其他指标检测对成年 NAFLD 患者纤维化分期和 NASH 诊断表现的大型系统评价中，共检索到 10,392 篇文献。去重及标题、摘要和全文筛选后，确定 59 项评估 VCTE 的研究。其中 37 项研究的作者提供了可用数据。部分作者将多项研究的数据合并提供，最终共收到 30 个数据集，包含 6571 例患者。去除重复（n=628）、缺失活检数据（n=14）和缺失 LSM-VCTE 数据（n=194）的病例后，最终数据集包含 5735 例独立患者。

### 研究与人群特征

30 个数据集的特征如下：研究在欧洲（67%）、亚洲（40%）和澳大利亚（3%）进行。FIB-4 和 NFS 分别可在 5393 例（94%）和 3248 例（57%）中计算。中位年龄为 54 岁，2570 例（45%）为女性，33% 患有糖尿病，43% 的 BMI ≥30 kg/m²。总体而言，30% 存在晚期肝纤维化，11% 存在肝硬化。30% 的晚期肝纤维化患病率与已发表的二级诊疗常规实践相符。NASH 存在于 50% 的患者中，且 67% 的晚期肝纤维化患者同时存在 NASH。

### 研究质量

基于 QUADAS-2 工具的方法学质量评估显示，仅 1 项研究在所有 QUADAS-2 领域均为低偏倚风险或低适用性风险。65% 的研究在"流程与时间"领域被判定为高偏倚风险或不明确风险，因为这些研究要么将技术失败排除在最终诊断表现分析之外，要么未报告相关信息。

### 验证 LSM-VCTE 和血清学检测的诊断表现

LSM-VCTE、FIB-4、NFS、APRI 和 AST/ALT 比值识别晚期肝纤维化的 AUROC 分别为 0.85、0.76、0.73、0.70 和 0.64；识别肝硬化的 AUROC 分别为 0.90、0.80、0.78、0.72 和 0.69。LSM-VCTE 在检测晚期肝纤维化和肝硬化方面均显著优于所有血清学检测（p<10⁻¹⁵）。在同时拥有三种检测的患者中进行头对头比较，该关系仍然成立。

评估文献中的成对切点显示：低阈值对应更高的灵敏度，高阈值对应更高的特异度。APRI 和 AST/ALT 比值仅具有中等诊断表现（AUROC ≤0.70），因此不再进一步考虑。

所有单一阈值均无法同时达到高灵敏度（≥80%）和高特异度（≥80%），故探索了下切点和上切点联合使用的策略。LSM-VCTE 的文献成对切点中，有两组表现良好：<7.1 kPa 且 ≥14.1 kPa（灵敏度 83%，特异度 90%）；<7.9 kPa 且 ≥9.6 kPa（灵敏度 84%，特异度 78%）。其他 NIT 成对切点虽特异度较高（如 FIB-4 <1.3 且 ≥2.67 的组合特异度为 91%），但灵敏度 <60%。此外，血清学 NITs 的不确定比例 >30%。IPD 研究组确定的成对切点未能在降低误分类和不确定比例方面优于文献切点。

进一步评估了血清学 NITs 与 LSM-VCTE 序贯联合诊断晚期肝纤维化的表现。将文献已有的 FIB-4 和 NFS 成对切点（FIB-4: <1.3 且 ≥2.67、<1.3 且 ≥3.25；NFS: <−1.455 且 ≥0.676）与 LSM-VCTE 的最佳成对切点（<7.9 kPa 且 ≥9.6 kPa）联合时，不确定组比例为 5%。虽然 FIB-4+LSM-VCTE 和 NFS+LSM-VCTE 序贯组合的特异度均 >80%，但灵敏度 ≤80%。使用 IPD 研究组确定的切点（FIB-4: <0.88 且 ≥2.31；NFS: <−2.55 且 ≥0.28）可获得更高灵敏度，但不确定比例接近 20%，且需行 LSM-VCTE 的患者比例也高于文献切点。

### 减少肝活检需求的算法

在推导集中，肝硬化诊断的 95% 和 98% 特异度对应切点分别为：LSM-VCTE 20.4 kPa 和 27.6 kPa、FIB-4 3.48 和 4.63、NFS 1.01 和 1.57。这些切点在验证集中表现相似。

将 FIB-4（下切点 1.3，上切点取整为 3.48 和 4.63）与 LSM-VCTE（下切点取整为 8.0 kPa，上切点取整为 20.0 kPa 和 28.0 kPa）联合后，与传统策略（LSM-VCTE 切点取整为 8.0 kPa 和 10.0 kPa）进行比较。此方法增加了需行 LSM 的患者比例（从 34% 增至 40% 和 44%），但减少了需肝活检的患者比例：使用 95% 特异度切点时从 33% 降至 19%，使用 98% 特异度切点时从 33% 降至 24%。然而，在 656 例被"纳入"为肝硬化的患者中，345 例实际上组织学上并无肝硬化。

### 亚组和敏感性分析

- **BMI**: 在较低 BMI 患者中，NITs 的诊断表现更佳（LSM-VCTE AUROC: 0.91, p<0.005；FIB-4: 0.81, p<0.001；NFS: 0.76, p<0.025）。
- **糖尿病**: 无 2 型糖尿病患者的 NITs 表现优于糖尿病患者（LSM-VCTE AUROC: 0.87, p<10⁻⁶；FIB-4: 0.77, p<0.01）。
- **活检质量**: 在活检长度 <20 mm 或汇管区 <11 个的样本中，NITs 的诊断表现反而更好。
- **年龄**: 最年轻年龄四分位（<43 岁）的 NFS 表现最差（AUROC: 0.58, p<0.001）；而在肝硬化诊断中，LSM-VCTE 在最年轻年龄组表现更好（AUROC: 0.97, p<10⁻⁴）。
- **转氨酶**: ALT 正常者 FIB-4 表现较差；AST ≥100 者 NFS 表现较差。
- **VCTE 可靠性**: 根据 Boursier 标准判定为不可靠的 LSM 测量，其诊断晚期肝纤维化和肝硬化的表现均显著更差（p<10⁻⁸）；不可靠测量在晚期肝纤维化和肝硬化组中的比例均为 12%。
- **探头类型**: 同时接受 M 和 XL 两种探头测量的患者亚组中，两者诊断表现无差异。
- **大洲来源**: 大洲来源对任何 NIT 均无显著影响。

---

## 讨论

通过与原始研究作者的广泛合作，本研究收集了迄今为止该领域最大的数据集。该数据集包括来自欧洲、亚洲和澳大利亚的多样化研究组，其中 30% 存在晚期肝纤维化，因此本研究结果适用于这些地区二级诊疗的典型患者群体，可用于开发新策略或巩固既有的患者转诊评估实践。

总体而言，LSM-VCTE 对晚期肝纤维化的诊断表现良好（AUROC=0.85），而 FIB-4 和 NFS 在相同人群中的表现为中等（FIB-4 AUROC=0.76，NFS AUROC=0.73）。所有研究的 NITs 均无法在单一切点下同时达到 ≥80% 的灵敏度和特异度。对肝硬化的诊断表现优于晚期肝纤维化，与既往研究一致。在以 Youden 指数最大化的单一切点（LSM-VCTE 9.1 kPa）下，灵敏度为 77%，特异度为 78%；以其双切点（<7.4 kPa 且 ≥12.1 kPa）使用时，灵敏度为 84%，特异度为 87%。

序贯组合策略可提高灵敏度和特异度。FIB-4（<1.3；≥2.67）后再行 LSM-VCTE（<8.0；≥10.0 kPa）的灵敏度为 66%、特异度为 86%，33% 的患者需接受肝活检；而采用肝硬化纳入的改良方案——FIB-4（<1.3；≥3.48）后再行 LSM-VCTE（<8.0；≥20.0 kPa）——仅有 19% 的患者需肝活检，但灵敏度降至 38%。当采用 98% 特异度切点（FIB-4 ≥4.63 和 LSM-VCTE ≥28.0 kPa）时，需肝活检比例可进一步降至 24%。

在 "ruled-in" 组中，656 例患者中有 345 例实际上组织学上并无肝硬化。对此需从两方面理解：一方面，肝活检本身的局限性可能导致这些患者的假阴性分类；另一方面，这些组织学上无肝硬化但 NIT 值高的患者可能与组织学上确诊肝硬化的患者具有同等的临床风险。既往丙型肝炎文献已表明，肝活检无肝硬化但 FIB-4 >3.25 的患者经抗病毒治疗后仍具有 HCC 发生的显著风险——这表明 NITs 可以带来超出单纯组织学诊断之外的附加价值。

亚组分析发现，NITs 在活检质量较差的病例中诊断准确性反而更高，此前在临床试验筛选人群中也有类似发现。可能与使用当地活检报告作为参考标准以及病理报告观察者间的高变异性有关。光谱偏倚已被排除（活检长度较短者在晚期肝纤维化和肝硬化组中的比例近乎相同）。

NITs 在较低 BMI 和无糖尿病患者中表现更好，主要由 BMI 驱动（BMI 与 2 型糖尿病间可能存在因果关联）。年龄对 NIT 表现也有影响——FIB-4 和 NFS 的年龄依赖性在意料之中，因年龄是两者算法中的组成部分；但难以解释为何年龄最小组在肝硬化诊断中表现更好。

### 局限性

本研究存在以下局限：无来自美国的数据且来自澳大利亚的研究极少，因此结果不宜直接外推至全球（人群 BMI 差异）；须使用当地提供的组织学结果，可能引入偏倚；研究跨越较长时间段，期间 LSM-VCTE 应用经历了显著变化（XL 探头的引入、皮肤-包膜距离测量及自动探头选择工具的应用）；早期研究仅使用 M 探头覆盖所有患者，仅部分研究评估皮肤-包膜距离以指导探头选择；三分之一的研究在法国进行，因 VCTE 技术起源于此；NITs 的表现对 2 型糖尿病和 BMI 存在一定依赖性，且在肝硬化检测中亦如此，但本研究未针对亚组优化切点——这应成为未来研究的方向。

本研究考察了一些最为广泛使用的 NITs。虽未穷尽所有检测，但可作为新 NITs 检测的基准——新检测（如 FibroTest-FibroSURE、ELF、FAST 评分、NIS4、cTAG）正不断涌现。

### 结论

本研究进一步验证了序贯联合使用 FIB-4 和 LSM-VCTE 可有效排除可于初级保健中安全管理的 NAFLD 晚期肝纤维化患者。同时，本研究展示了如何通过联合使用较低切点排除晚期肝纤维化和较高切点纳入肝硬化，来减少需接受肝活检的患者数量。

# 基于个体患者数据荟萃分析评估无创检测对 NAFLD 患者晚期肝纤维化的诊断准确性

## ——一篇已发表论文的结构化重述

> **原文献信息**  
> Mózes FE, Lee JA, Selvaraj EA, et al. Diagnostic accuracy of non-invasive tests for advanced fibrosis in patients with NAFLD: an individual patient data meta-analysis. *Gut*. 2022 May;71(5):1006–1019.  
> **DOI**: [10.1136/gutjnl-2021-324243](https://doi.org/10.1136/gutjnl-2021-324243)  
> **PMID**: 34001645  
> **PMCID**: [PMC8995830](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC8995830/)  
> **PROSPERO 注册号**: CRD42019157661  
> **许可协议**: CC BY-NC 4.0  
> **说明**: 以下内容是对原文献的结构化科学重述，所有方法、样本量、主要数值、局限性和结论均来自可核验原文；非逐字复制。

---

## 摘要

**目的**: 在非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD）患者中，肝活检目前仍然是纤维化分期的必要手段。本研究旨在评估振动控制瞬时弹性成像测量的肝脏硬度（LSM-VCTE）、Fibrosis-4 指数（FIB-4）和 NAFLD 纤维化评分（NFS）各自的诊断表现，并推导可减少肝活检需求的诊断策略。

**设计**: 对以肝组织学为参考标准评估 LSM-VCTE 的研究进行个体患者数据荟萃分析（IPDMA）。在数据可获取的情况下计算 FIB-4 和 NFS。计算灵敏度、特异度和受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）。对各标志物单独及序贯联合使用进行评估。

**结果**: 纳入 37 项原始研究的数据（n=5735；女性 45%；中位年龄 54 岁；中位体重指数 30 kg/m²；33% 患有 2 型糖尿病；30% 存在晚期肝纤维化）。LSM-VCTE、FIB-4 和 NFS 单独诊断晚期肝纤维化的 AUROC 分别为 0.85、0.76 和 0.73。序贯联合使用 FIB-4 切点（<1.3；≥2.67）后再行 LSM-VCTE（<8.0；≥10.0 kPa）以排除或纳入晚期肝纤维化，灵敏度（95% CI）为 66%（63–68），特异度为 86%（84–87），33% 的患者仍需肝活检以确定最终诊断。FIB-4 切点（<1.3；≥3.48）后接 LSM-VCTE 切点（<8.0；≥20.0 kPa）以排除晚期肝纤维化或纳入肝硬化，灵敏度为 38%（37–39），特异度为 90%（89–91），19% 的患者需肝活检。

**结论**: 采用较低切点排除晚期肝纤维化、较高切点纳入肝硬化的序贯联合策略，可减少肝活检需求。

---

## 引言

非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD）是代谢综合征的肝脏表现，全球患病率较高。大多数患者长期无明显症状且疾病进展缓慢，但少数会进展为肝硬化、肝功能衰竭和肝细胞癌（HCC）。NAFLD 的组织学特征包括单纯性脂肪变性到伴有小叶炎症和肝细胞气球样变的脂肪性肝炎，两者均可伴随不同程度的纤维化。目前公认的 NAFLD 诊断参考标准仍是肝活检，然而肝活检为侵入性检查且存在并发症风险，同时受限于取样变异性和观察者间病理报告的一致性差异。

NAFLD 通常在血液检查中发现肝转氨酶升高，或在影像学检查中发现肝脏脂肪变性或肝硬化后偶然诊断。临床医生面临的挑战之一是识别哪些患者具有较高的进展或临床结局风险，因为这些患者可从专科随访中获益。现有大量证据表明，至少存在晚期肝纤维化（F3–4）的患者在后期发生肝脏相关事件的风险更高。

已有大量证据表明无创检测（NITs）可用于对患者进行晚期肝纤维化风险分层。这些方法通常涉及序贯应用两种 NITs：第一层在社区进行简单、廉价的血清学检测（如 FIB-4 或 NFS），随后第二层进行肝脏硬度测量（LSM）（如 VCTE）或专有血清学检测（如增强肝纤维化检测，ELF）。每层检测通常使用一个下切点和一个上切点来分别排除（NIT 结果低于下切点者）或纳入（NIT 结果高于上切点者）晚期肝纤维化高风险患者。两轮检测结果均处于不确定区间的患者仍需肝活检进行风险分层。这些方法的主要价值在于其高阴性预测值，可用于排除低风险患者，使其在初级保健中安全管理。

然而，这些方法的若干应用方面仍需进一步明确。首先，关于应使用哪些 NIT 阈值尚无共识——如 FIB-4 的上切点有 3.25 和 2.67 等不同报道。其次，NITs 在特定患者亚组（如糖尿病或肥胖患者）中的表现仍存在不确定性。此外，对于被判定为晚期肝纤维化高风险的患者，仍需通过肝活检识别肝硬化以进行 HCC 监测。因此，开发可减少二级诊疗中肝活检需求的策略是一个尚未满足的需求。

为此，本研究开展了一项 IPDMA，主要目的有三：（1）评估 LSM-VCTE 的诊断表现，并与 FIB-4 和 NFS 作为排除晚期肝纤维化的筛查工具进行比较；（2）评估 NIT 联合策略以最小化二级诊疗中需肝活检的病例数；（3）探索影响诊断准确性的因素。

---

## 方法

### 方案注册与报告规范

本 IPDMA 依照 PRISMA-IPD 声明进行报告，并在 PROSPERO 注册（CRD42019157661）。

### 纳入标准

**受试者**: 报告有 NAFLD 且同时具备肝组织学和 LSM-VCTE 数据的成年患者（≥18 岁）的研究均可纳入。若研究纳入混合病因的患者，仅提取其中 NAFLD 患者的个体数据。

**目标检测**: 主要目标检测为使用 FibroScan（Echosens，法国）进行的 LSM-VCTE。在数据可获取的情况下，同时计算血清学生物标志物 NFS、FIB-4、AST/ALT 比值和 APRI。对于 LSM-VCTE，最常使用的排除和纳入晚期肝纤维化的切点分别为 <7.9 kPa 和 ≥9.6 kPa。

**参考标准**: 仅纳入基于 NASH 临床研究网络（NASH CRN）分期系统报告肝纤维化组织学分级的研究。

**目标状态**: 晚期肝纤维化（F3–4）和肝硬化（F4）。为达成研究目标，切点分别用于排除或纳入晚期肝纤维化，以及排除晚期肝纤维化或纳入肝硬化。

**研究设计**: 所有报告 NAFLD 患者在肝活检前后 6 个月内接受 LSM-VCTE 检查的研究均可纳入，无语言限制。

### 合作建立

通过电子邮件联系合格研究的作者，若 2 周内未收到回复则发送提醒。仅使用已获伦理批准的研究数据。由于仅接收匿名数据，本荟萃分析未另行申请伦理批准。

### 数据验证

对研究者提供的个体患者测量值进行范围检查，必要时要求作者澄清。缺失数据持续追踪直至收到或确认不可获取，分析中采用成对删除法处理缺失数据。

将中位硬度 ≥7.1 kPa 且 IQR/中位 LSM 比值 >30% 的测量视为不可靠。这些数据纳入主要分析，随后在亚组分析中与可靠测量进行比较，以评估其是否可用于可靠诊断晚期肝纤维化。

向作者提供数据模板并要求在可能的情况下去重。同时检查是否存在重复条目，如发现则予以删除。

### 数据分析

**质量与偏倚评估**: 使用 QUADAS-2 工具评估研究质量。

**IPD 荟萃分析**: 合并原始数据集并添加研究识别变量，进行描述性统计分析。分类变量以百分比表示，连续变量以均数 ± 标准差或中位数与四分位距报告。

分析按方案进行（无失败的 LSM-VCTE 信息）。构建非参数经验 ROC 曲线评估诊断表现，基于 De Long 方法计算 AUROC 及 95% CI。AUROC 的组间比较采用 De Long 检验统计量。

报告最大化 Youden 指数、90% 灵敏度和 90% 特异度对应的切点，同时评估已发表文献切点的诊断表现。通过计算灵敏度、特异度以及误分类和不确定患者的比例来评估血清标志物与 LSM-VCTE 的序贯联合策略。

在原始研究报告的患病率范围内估算 PPV 和 NPV，同时报告每 100 例理论病例中的假阳性和假阴性数。

主要分析对每种 NIT 最大化可用数据。为有效比较 NITs 的诊断表现，在同时拥有 VCTE、FIB-4 和 NFS 数据的患者亚组中进行单独的头对头分析。

为实现减少肝活检需求的策略开发，采用较低切点排除晚期肝纤维化、较高切点纳入肝硬化。肝硬化的上切点从推导集中分别选择 95% 和 98% 特异度所对应的值，并在验证集中检验。推导集和验证集通过从 IPD 研究组中以 3:2 比例随机抽样获得。然后将这些上切点与文献中的晚期肝纤维化排除下切点联合，在整个 IPD 研究组中检验。为便于临床使用，还将 7.9 kPa 和 9.6 kPa 取整为 8.0 kPa 和 10.0 kPa，将肝硬化的切点也取整至最近整数。

仅将检测阳性和阴性的患者纳入诊断性能指标计算，不确定区间内的患者被排除。

**亚组分析**: 按以下变量分层：活检长度（<20 mm、≥20 mm）、汇管区数量（<11、≥11）、活检质量（中等：10 mm ≤ 长度 <20 mm；高质量：长度 ≥20 mm 且 ≥11 个汇管区）、年龄（四分位数）、性别、BMI（<25 kg/m²、25–30 kg/m²、≥30 kg/m²）、是否患 2 型糖尿病、来源大洲（欧洲、亚洲）、探头类型（M、XL）、LSM-VCTE 可靠性标准以及转氨酶水平（ALT 或 AST <40、40–100、≥100；ALT <40 且 AST <40、ALT ≥40 或 AST ≥40）。

所有统计采用 R（V.1.2.1335）的 pROC 包完成；95% CI 基于 boot 包采用 500 次分层 bootstrap 重抽样计算。

## 结果

### 检索流程与数据收集

在一项评估 LSM-VCTE 和其他指标检测对成年 NAFLD 患者纤维化分期和 NASH 诊断表现的大型系统评价中，共检索到 10,392 篇文献。去重及标题、摘要和全文筛选后，确定 59 项评估 VCTE 的研究。其中 37 项研究的作者提供了可用数据。部分作者将多项研究的数据合并提供，最终共收到 30 个数据集，包含 6571 例患者。去除重复（n=628）、缺失活检数据（n=14）和缺失 LSM-VCTE 数据（n=194）的病例后，最终数据集包含 5735 例独立患者。

### 研究与人群特征

30 个数据集的特征如下：研究在欧洲（67%）、亚洲（40%）和澳大利亚（3%）进行。FIB-4 和 NFS 分别可在 5393 例（94%）和 3248 例（57%）中计算。中位年龄为 54 岁，2570 例（45%）为女性，33% 患有糖尿病，43% 的 BMI ≥30 kg/m²。总体而言，30% 存在晚期肝纤维化，11% 存在肝硬化。30% 的晚期肝纤维化患病率与已发表的二级诊疗常规实践相符。NASH 存在于 50% 的患者中，且 67% 的晚期肝纤维化患者同时存在 NASH。

### 研究质量

基于 QUADAS-2 工具的方法学质量评估显示，仅 1 项研究在所有 QUADAS-2 领域均为低偏倚风险或低适用性风险。65% 的研究在"流程与时间"领域被判定为高偏倚风险或不明确风险，因为这些研究要么将技术失败排除在最终诊断表现分析之外，要么未报告相关信息。

### 验证 LSM-VCTE 和血清学检测的诊断表现

LSM-VCTE、FIB-4、NFS、APRI 和 AST/ALT 比值识别晚期肝纤维化的 AUROC 分别为 0.85、0.76、0.73、0.70 和 0.64；识别肝硬化的 AUROC 分别为 0.90、0.80、0.78、0.72 和 0.69。LSM-VCTE 在检测晚期肝纤维化和肝硬化方面均显著优于所有血清学检测（p<10⁻¹⁵）。在同时拥有三种检测的患者中进行头对头比较，该关系仍然成立。

评估文献中的成对切点显示：低阈值对应更高的灵敏度，高阈值对应更高的特异度。APRI 和 AST/ALT 比值仅具有中等诊断表现（AUROC ≤0.70），因此不再进一步考虑。

所有单一阈值均无法同时达到高灵敏度（≥80%）和高特异度（≥80%），故探索了下切点和上切点联合使用的策略。LSM-VCTE 的文献成对切点中，有两组表现良好：<7.1 kPa 且 ≥14.1 kPa（灵敏度 83%，特异度 90%）；<7.9 kPa 且 ≥9.6 kPa（灵敏度 84%，特异度 78%）。其他 NIT 成对切点虽特异度较高（如 FIB-4 <1.3 且 ≥2.67 的组合特异度为 91%），但灵敏度 <60%。此外，血清学 NITs 的不确定比例 >30%。IPD 研究组确定的成对切点未能在降低误分类和不确定比例方面优于文献切点。

进一步评估了血清学 NITs 与 LSM-VCTE 序贯联合诊断晚期肝纤维化的表现。将文献已有的 FIB-4 和 NFS 成对切点（FIB-4: <1.3 且 ≥2.67、<1.3 且 ≥3.25；NFS: <−1.455 且 ≥0.676）与 LSM-VCTE 的最佳成对切点（<7.9 kPa 且 ≥9.6 kPa）联合时，不确定组比例为 5%。虽然 FIB-4+LSM-VCTE 和 NFS+LSM-VCTE 序贯组合的特异度均 >80%，但灵敏度 ≤80%。使用 IPD 研究组确定的切点（FIB-4: <0.88 且 ≥2.31；NFS: <−2.55 且 ≥0.28）可获得更高灵敏度，但不确定比例接近 20%，且需行 LSM-VCTE 的患者比例也高于文献切点。

### 减少肝活检需求的算法

在推导集中，肝硬化诊断的 95% 和 98% 特异度对应切点分别为：LSM-VCTE 20.4 kPa 和 27.6 kPa、FIB-4 3.48 和 4.63、NFS 1.01 和 1.57。这些切点在验证集中表现相似。

将 FIB-4（下切点 1.3，上切点取整为 3.48 和 4.63）与 LSM-VCTE（下切点取整为 8.0 kPa，上切点取整为 20.0 kPa 和 28.0 kPa）联合后，与传统策略（LSM-VCTE 切点取整为 8.0 kPa 和 10.0 kPa）进行比较。此方法增加了需行 LSM 的患者比例（从 34% 增至 40% 和 44%），但减少了需肝活检的患者比例：使用 95% 特异度切点时从 33% 降至 19%，使用 98% 特异度切点时从 33% 降至 24%。然而，在 656 例被"纳入"为肝硬化的患者中，345 例实际上组织学上并无肝硬化。

### 亚组和敏感性分析

- **BMI**: 在较低 BMI 患者中，NITs 的诊断表现更佳（LSM-VCTE AUROC: 0.91, p<0.005；FIB-4: 0.81, p<0.001；NFS: 0.76, p<0.025）。
- **糖尿病**: 无 2 型糖尿病患者的 NITs 表现优于糖尿病患者（LSM-VCTE AUROC: 0.87, p<10⁻⁶；FIB-4: 0.77, p<0.01）。
- **活检质量**: 在活检长度 <20 mm 或汇管区 <11 个的样本中，NITs 的诊断表现反而更好。
- **年龄**: 最年轻年龄四分位（<43 岁）的 NFS 表现最差（AUROC: 0.58, p<0.001）；而在肝硬化诊断中，LSM-VCTE 在最年轻年龄组表现更好（AUROC: 0.97, p<10⁻⁴）。
- **转氨酶**: ALT 正常者 FIB-4 表现较差；AST ≥100 者 NFS 表现较差。
- **VCTE 可靠性**: 根据 Boursier 标准判定为不可靠的 LSM 测量，其诊断晚期肝纤维化和肝硬化的表现均显著更差（p<10⁻⁸）；不可靠测量在晚期肝纤维化和肝硬化组中的比例均为 12%。
- **探头类型**: 同时接受 M 和 XL 两种探头测量的患者亚组中，两者诊断表现无差异。
- **大洲来源**: 大洲来源对任何 NIT 均无显著影响。

## 讨论

通过与原始研究作者的广泛合作，本研究收集了迄今为止该领域最大的数据集。该数据集包括来自欧洲、亚洲和澳大利亚的多样化研究组，其中 30% 存在晚期肝纤维化，因此本研究结果适用于这些地区二级诊疗的典型患者群体，可用于开发新策略或巩固既有的患者转诊评估实践。

总体而言，LSM-VCTE 对晚期肝纤维化的诊断表现良好（AUROC=0.85），而 FIB-4 和 NFS 在相同人群中的表现为中等（FIB-4 AUROC=0.76，NFS AUROC=0.73）。所有研究的 NITs 均无法在单一切点下同时达到 ≥80% 的灵敏度和特异度。对肝硬化的诊断表现优于晚期肝纤维化，与既往研究一致。在以 Youden 指数最大化的单一切点（LSM-VCTE 9.1 kPa）下，灵敏度为 77%，特异度为 78%；以其双切点（<7.4 kPa 且 ≥12.1 kPa）使用时，灵敏度为 84%，特异度为 87%。

序贯组合策略可提高灵敏度和特异度。FIB-4（<1.3；≥2.67）后再行 LSM-VCTE（<8.0；≥10.0 kPa）的灵敏度为 66%、特异度为 86%，33% 的患者需接受肝活检；而采用肝硬化纳入的改良方案——FIB-4（<1.3；≥3.48）后再行 LSM-VCTE（<8.0；≥20.0 kPa）——仅有 19% 的患者需肝活检，但灵敏度降至 38%。当采用 98% 特异度切点（FIB-4 ≥4.63 和 LSM-VCTE ≥28.0 kPa）时，需肝活检比例可进一步降至 24%。

在 "ruled-in" 组中，656 例患者中有 345 例实际上组织学上并无肝硬化。对此需从两方面理解：一方面，肝活检本身的局限性可能导致这些患者的假阴性分类；另一方面，这些组织学上无肝硬化但 NIT 值高的患者可能与组织学上确诊肝硬化的患者具有同等的临床风险。既往丙型肝炎文献已表明，肝活检无肝硬化但 FIB-4 >3.25 的患者经抗病毒治疗后仍具有 HCC 发生的显著风险——这表明 NITs 可以带来超出单纯组织学诊断之外的附加价值。

亚组分析发现，NITs 在活检质量较差的病例中诊断准确性反而更高，此前在临床试验筛选人群中也有类似发现。可能与使用当地活检报告作为参考标准以及病理报告观察者间的高变异性有关。光谱偏倚已被排除（活检长度较短者在晚期肝纤维化和肝硬化组中的比例近乎相同）。

NITs 在较低 BMI 和无糖尿病患者中表现更好，主要由 BMI 驱动（BMI 与 2 型糖尿病间可能存在因果关联）。年龄对 NIT 表现也有影响——FIB-4 和 NFS 的年龄依赖性在意料之中，因年龄是两者算法中的组成部分；但难以解释为何年龄最小组在肝硬化诊断中表现更好。

### 局限性

本研究存在以下局限：无来自美国的数据且来自澳大利亚的研究极少，因此结果不宜直接外推至全球（人群 BMI 差异）；须使用当地提供的组织学结果，可能引入偏倚；研究跨越较长时间段，期间 LSM-VCTE 应用经历了显著变化（XL 探头的引入、皮肤-包膜距离测量及自动探头选择工具的应用）；早期研究仅使用 M 探头覆盖所有患者，仅部分研究评估皮肤-包膜距离以指导探头选择；三分之一的研究在法国进行，因 VCTE 技术起源于此；NITs 的表现对 2 型糖尿病和 BMI 存在一定依赖性，且在肝硬化检测中亦如此，但本研究未针对亚组优化切点——这应成为未来研究的方向。

本研究考察了一些最为广泛使用的 NITs。虽未穷尽所有检测，但可作为新 NITs 检测的基准——新检测（如 FibroTest-FibroSURE、ELF、FAST 评分、NIS4、cTAG）正不断涌现。

### 结论

本研究进一步验证了序贯联合使用 FIB-4 和 LSM-VCTE 可有效排除可于初级保健中安全管理的 NAFLD 晚期肝纤维化患者。同时，本研究展示了如何通过联合使用较低切点排除晚期肝纤维化和较高切点纳入肝硬化，来减少需接受肝活检的患者数量。
